AMENDED_AC (Gap Analysis — staleness gate): reviewer-base.md content hash is verified by the pre-commit staleness check in pre-commit-review-gate.sh. After T2 commits the updated reviewer-base.md, the 10 agent files will be stale. T4's rebuild MUST be committed before any other commit to the session branch, or the staleness gate will block. 

Ensure T4 builds and stages the 10 agent files in the same commit sequence as the reviewer-base.md change. The staleness check recomputes hash from reviewer-base.md + delta content — running build-review-agents.sh and staging the rebuilt .md files satisfies it.

Additional verify: after running build-review-agents.sh, check no {{...}} substitution token survived in any agent file:
  REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && grep -rn '{{[A-Z_]*}}' "$REPO_ROOT/plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-*.md" && echo 'WARNING: unresolved tokens' || echo 'OK: no unresolved tokens'
